notes: The 2002 text (and the same text at SR5 of 2014) has no 2023 twin: 2023 drops it and types a group subordinate to a strong record by position (GR2). AddressOfOperandScreen.Admit refuses, below 2023, a group entry that is strongly typed (StrongRoot present) but whose own StrongType flag is not set, i.e. a group with no TYPE clause of its own referencing a STRONG declaration (COBOL2785, citing the edition's rule), for every ADDRESS OF surface (SET, CALL, INVOKE, relation operand), because they all reach the one screen (kb/Work PB1407); a group that carries its own TYPE clause stays legal (pb5705-address-of-strong-group-own-type). kb/Work PB5705.
